<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="soul-devourers" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Soul Devourers</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are 6 types of soul devourers, ranging from 105 to 117 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The Magister may also be killed for this task, requiring 115 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The mobs each require a different level of attention, and the profits differ.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Magister will give 8000 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> experience per kill and benefit from the use of Tuska's Wrath </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="Tuskas" title="Tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but the slayer helmet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> effect does not work on him.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Key to the Crossing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1" alt="keytothecrossing" title="keytothecrossing" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped at a rate of 1/75 on task, which can be increased to 1/60 with the use of Sophanem slayer dungeon drop enhancers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vital Spark </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426807893032963.png?v=1" alt="vitalspark" title="vitalspark" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be doubled via the use of vital spark drop enhancers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Soul devourers each have their own drop tables, containing good alchables and other resources, making them a consistent moneymaker.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Sophanem Slayer Dungeon contains chests which will </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon#Chest <nowiki>automatically gather drops</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sophanem Slayer Dungeon</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablets.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively, you can teleport to the Menaphos lodestone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032552289589796904.png?v=1" alt="menaphoslode" title="menaphoslode" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, take the bridge to Sophanem, and then run south to the dungeon entrance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sunken Pyramid (south-eastern room, 5 spawns)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the small room, position yourself anywhere near the center of all the spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For Imperial warrior akh's stand in the northern part of the room and target southern spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_Slayer_Dungeon_teleport <nowiki>Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport</nowiki>]<nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vital_spark_drop_enhancer <nowiki>Vital spark drop enhancer</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Gives an additional vital spark </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426807893032963.png?v=1" alt="vitalspark" title="vitalspark" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if gotten as a drop.
    • Can be purchased for 1000 Dungeoneering tokens </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sophanem_slayer_dungeon_drop_enhancer <nowiki>Sophanem slayer dungeon drop enhancers</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Increases chance to get Key to the Crossing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1048592046409138217.png?v=1" alt="keytothecrossing" title="keytothecrossing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> drops.
    • Can be purchased for 10,000 Dungeoneering tokens </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/762960358930907156.png?v=1" alt="dungtoken" title="dungtoken" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

The lowest level soul devourer, they do weak melee attacks and have no special mechanics, making them easy to AFK.</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="feline-akh"><ins><nowiki>Feline Akh</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/oy7rulc.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
Feline akh's have harder hitting attacks than Salawas, and a special attack which deals high magic damage and makes nearby feline akh's aggressive towards you. This occurs when the mob reaches 2500 life points, and hits when the bar above their head fully charges. Despite this, they can very easily be AFK'd in the same method as Salawas, and are often killed for their common elite clue drops </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1123586941057769552.png?v=1" alt="eliteclue" title="eliteclue" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Due to their harder hitting attacks, the usage of a vampyrism scrimshaw </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is recommended, as the player should be praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 536.2</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>

<h3 id="method-afk-melee_1"><nowiki>Method - AFK Melee</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><h2 id="disclaimer_1"><nowiki>⚠️ Disclaimer</nowiki></h2><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026</nowiki></strong></p><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>!</nowiki></p><nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="crocodile-akh"><ins><nowiki>Crocodile Akh</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/xgLCv4o.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
Due to their low life points their dangerous special attack can be ignored. After 5 auto-attacks, they strike the floor to deal a large 3000 hit through deflect prayers. With a good setup they can be AFK'd. At 105 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> it is possible to use Wilder Pies to boost, to kill these; however, at 111 Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> it is recommended to move on to the Imperial akhs via the usage of a Wilder Pie.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
